claims.claim: Exact centered score/log-probability slope on nonflat legal support; affine score gauge preserves conditional probabilities, so independent physical energy calibration is required. Actual R87 215040 selections,210720 identifiable and4320 flat; R79 30720 waves,29760 identifiable and960 flat; controlled B16 training selects the programmed slope for all8 conditions, Q-only NLL worse in all36 nonzero-control L21 pointwise comparisons.
claims.limit: Algorithmic conditional score law, not physical temperature or hypothetical policy trajectories; existing independent cohorts.

claims.claim: For fixed legal feature f, KL projection onto softmax(b f) obeys moment matching and constrained Pythagorean correction; temporal mixture gap separates changing laws from static projection residual. 62400 projections, all independently bisected; 62078 interior,110 finite-bound,212 support-face; 64 scaling fits, development-selected fresh L21 B64 wins/ties6/16 including two trivial uniform A controls (4/14 nontrivial).
claims.limit: Fixed feature and finite signed bounded slope, no population or physical temperature scaling.

claims.claim: Predictable visit residual E(X-A)=0; across independent repeats cross feature moment has expectation zero, self-feature moment need not. Exact self-minus-cross empirical covariance identity tested across3200 root/stratum blocks and26400 ordered pairs.
